newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal authorised borrow up to 2,225 bln esc '97.
newsitem.headline: Portugal authorised borrow up to 2,225 bln esc '97.

text.p: Portugal's cabinet authorised total borrowing worth up to 2,225 billion escudos in 1997, a spokesman said.

The borrowing includes the issue of fixed rate Treasury bonds worth up to 775 billion escudos and seven-year floating rate bonds, with an option for total or partial reimbursement from 2001, worth up to 780 billion escudos.

The Portuguese state is authorised to issue savings certificates worth up to 320 billion escudos, the spokesman said. The cabinet also authorised the Institute of Management of Public Credit to borrow up to 350 billion escudos abroad.
